# GALLERY

![](https://troycondogarages.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/293856347_101769785949118_3680151206583370806_n-Edited.png)

Owned by Mark & Valerie Sylla, we offer premium **garage condo units for purchase** in Hudson, WI. Our facility provides high-end, climate-controlled **personal use space** for vehicle storage and private collections. Build equity in a professional-grade sanctuary designed for your lifestyle—not for residential living.
